:::{#exr-matmul-product-of-sums-practice}
#### Expanding a product of two matrix sums

When a [product](#def-matrix-mult) of two [matrix sums](#def-matrix-addition) is expanded,
each of the four terms keeps its factors in their original order,
as @thm-matmul-product-of-sums notes,
because a product of two [matrices](#def-matrix) can change when its factors swap.
Let $\matr{A}$, $\matr{B}$ and $\matr{C}$ be $k \times k$ matrices.

Find the four terms in the expansion of $(\matr{A} + \matr{B})(\matr{A} + \matr{C})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Apply @thm-matmul-product-of-sums with $\matr{A} + \matr{B}$ as its left factor
and $\matr{A} + \matr{C}$ as its right factor.

:::
